title: Frog dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#1a3a1a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- left leg (back, kicking up) -->
  <path d='M30 72 Q18 62 14 50' stroke='#2e8b2e' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left foot -->
  <ellipse cx='13' cy='48' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3cb43c' transform='rotate(-30 13 48)'/>
  <!-- toe bumps -->
  <circle cx='8' cy='45' r='2' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <circle cx='11' cy='43' r='2' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='43' r='2' fill='#5cd65c'/>

  <!-- right leg (front, bent) -->
  <path d='M62 74 Q72 78 76 84' stroke='#2e8b2e' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right foot -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='86' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#3cb43c' transform='rotate(15 78 86)'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='83' r='2' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='87' r='2' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='89' r='2' fill='#5cd65c'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='60' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#3cb43c'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='54' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#5cd65c'/>

  <!-- left arm (raised, waving) -->
  <path d='M34 52 Q24 40 20 28' stroke='#2e8b2e' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left hand -->
  <circle cx='19' cy='26' r='5' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='22' r='2' fill='#7ee87e'/>
  <circle cx='19' cy='20' r='2' fill='#7ee87e'/>
  <circle cx='23' cy='22' r='2' fill='#7ee87e'/>

  <!-- right arm (out to side) -->
  <path d='M64 56 Q76 52 82 46' stroke='#2e8b2e' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right hand -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='44' r='5' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='40' r='2' fill='#7ee87e'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='45' r='2' fill='#7ee87e'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='48' r='2' fill='#7ee87e'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='32' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#3cb43c'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='27' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#5cd65c'/>

  <!-- left eye bump -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='24' r='8' fill='#3cb43c'/>
  <!-- right eye bump -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='24' r='8' fill='#3cb43c'/>

  <!-- left eye white -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='23' r='6' fill='#e8ffe8'/>
  <!-- right eye white -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='23' r='6' fill='#e8ffe8'/>

  <!-- left pupil -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='23' r='3' fill='#0d2a0d'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='22' r='1' fill='#bfffbf'/>
  <!-- right pupil -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='23' r='3' fill='#0d2a0d'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='22' r='1' fill='#bfffbf'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 37 Q48 46 58 37' stroke='#1a5a1a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush left -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='34' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8fa0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- blush right -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='34' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8fa0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- little musical note -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='22' rx='3' ry='2.5' transform='rotate(-20 72 22)'/>
    <rect x='74' y='10' width='1.8' height='13' rx='0.9'/>
    <path d='M74 10 Q80 8 80 14 Q78 11 74 12 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff6a0'>
    <path d='M20 10 l1.5 3 l3 1.5 l-3 1.5 l-1.5 3 l-1.5 -3 l-3 -1.5 l3 -1.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M90 60 l1 2 l2 1 l-2 1 l-1 2 l-1 -2 l-2 -1 l2 -1 Z'/>
    <path d='M12 70 l1 2 l2 1 l-2 1 l-1 2 l-1 -2 l-2 -1 l2 -1 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
